scripts.dev: pnpm setup:local && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm -r --parallel --filter api --filter marketing --filter dashboard dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm setup:local && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --filter api dev
scripts.test: pnpm db:check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:workers
scripts.lint: oxlint && node lint/rules/prevent-markdown-docs.ts && pnpm lint:architecture && pnpm lint:effect && pnpm lint:env
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:browser
scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:remote && pnpm deploy:api && pnpm deploy:marketing && pnpm deploy:dashboard
scripts.deploy:marketing: pnpm --filter marketing build && pnpm --filter marketing run deploy
scripts.deploy:dashboard: pnpm --filter dashboard build && pnpm --filter dashboard run deploy
scripts.typecheck:tools: tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tests/support/workers/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/workers/tsconfig.json
